description: Binary-space-partition the input space into one cell per seed. Equal/weighted shares are measured on the clipped area (inside the boundary). Squarified layout keeps cells near-square; the adjacency matrix forces ticked pairs to share a wall.
instructions:
Binary-space-partitions the input Space into one cell per seed (`seeds`). Balance (`balance`) = Equal area or Weighted (a `weights` comma ratio list) — measured on the CLIPPED area (inside the boundary, so equal = equal m² even on L/concave shapes). Layout (`layout`) = Slicing (recursive BSP) or Squarified (near-square cells); `maxRatio` is a soft aspect target for slicing.

`useConnection` reveals an adjacency matrix on the node — tick pairs to force those cells to share a wall. `tiltAngle` rotates the cut frame. Preview openings (outer per-cell / inner per shared edge) draw door gaps so rooms read as connected. One handle per cell, or a single bundle. Tilt / max-aspect are wireable.

handles.outputCount: outputMode == 'single' ? 1 : (handleCount >= 1 ? min(40, round(handleCount)) : max(1, min(30, round(seeds))))
